step1.name: Plan and design template
actionsTaken: Reviewed existing templates: develop-user-story, review-and-verify, set-concept
Reviewed existing steps: understand-context, create-high-level-plan, design-implementation-plan, identify-files
Designed initial template structure with 5 steps
Identified 3 new steps needed: analyze-affected-system, gather-missing-information, create-low-level-design
Added new Step 1: Provide User Story Parameters with guideline-based approach
Simplified parameters to only userStoryId - details fetched in Step 1
agentReasoning: Chose to create standalone LLD template separate from develop-user-story because user wants design as foundational artifact for multiple SDLC phases
Reused understand-context step as it fits well for gathering user story requirements
Planned separate Q&A step because LLD requires complete information before design work
Simplified to single userStoryId parameter because actual story details are collected in Step 1 using team-specific guidelines

userInteractions.userRequest: Add a step before current Step 1 about providing user story parameters, using a guideline approach so each team can use their preferred method
userInteractions.reason: Teams have different ways of collecting user story information (Jira, requirements docs, interviews, etc.) - need flexibility
userInteractions.agentResponse: Revising design to add new Step 1: Provide User Story Parameters with guideline-based approach

userInteractions.userRequest: The parameter for the process template should be only the id of the user story
userInteractions.reason: Simplify template invocation - actual story details (title, description, acceptance criteria) are fetched/collected in Step 1 using guideline-based approach
userInteractions.agentResponse: Simplified parameters to single required parameter: userStoryId. All other details collected in Step 1.

userInteractions.userRequest: The 'source - where the info came from' is not really needed
userInteractions.reason: Unnecessary overhead - what matters is having the user story details, not tracking their origin
userInteractions.agentResponse: Removed source tracking from Step 1 outputs. Keeping it simple.

userInteractions.userRequest: 1) Rename 'Provide User Story Parameters' to 'Get User Story Parameters'. 2) Add a step before step 3 (Analyze Current System) for getting all relevant data/information from different sources, also using guideline approach
userInteractions.reason: 1) 'Get' is more accurate verb. 2) Need explicit step to gather information from various sources (docs, specs, existing designs) before system analysis
userInteractions.agentResponse: Renamed Step 1. Added new Step 3: Gather Relevant Information (guideline-based). Total now 7 steps.

userInteractions.userRequest: Q&A step should be about 'answering open questions' and should be part of other steps (Option C: as substep pattern)
userInteractions.reason: Q&A naturally occurs during multiple steps - having standalone Q&A step is artificial. Better to handle questions as they arise in each step.
userInteractions.agentResponse: Removed standalone Q&A step. Each step now handles its own Q&A as needed. Total now 6 steps.

userInteractions.userRequest: create-low-level-design step should also use guideline
userInteractions.reason: Teams have different LLD approaches - different diagram types, sections, formats, tools
userInteractions.agentResponse: Added guideline-based approach to Step 5 (Create Low-Level Design). Now 3 guideline-based steps.

userInteractions.reason: Need to confirm context understanding is correct before proceeding with information gathering and analysis
userInteractions.agentResponse: Added approval checkpoint to Step 2 (Understand User Story Context). Now 3 approval checkpoints.

userInteractions.userRequest: Change flow so Step 4 (Analyze Current System) and Step 5 (Create LLD) can return to Step 3 (Gather Relevant Information) if they need additional information
userInteractions.reason: During analysis or design creation, gaps in information may be discovered that require gathering more data
userInteractions.agentResponse: Added feedback loops from Steps 4 and 5 back to Step 3 when additional information is needed.

decisionsMade: Template category: development (for software development lifecycle)
Story details (title, description, acceptance criteria) collected in Step 1 via guideline-based approach
